conclusion: Four-tick demonstration exposure proved that ordinary 131-tick human replay can improve terminal sample efficiency without capping the generated policy: the learner retained a tick-130 authenticated candidate. Prior scratch failures were confounded by a 160-tick route cap and by global peer frontiers collapsing parallel exploration. A proper 1,024-tick from-scratch campaign with global training evidence but lane-local frontier coverage found authenticated terminals in 3/4 seeds at ticks 228, 332, and 246. Terminal value was learned and reused without demonstration transitions, incumbent tape, or authored route coordinates. Reliable scratch discovery is established; P3 remains incomplete because the scratch policy has not shortened its best route below the 131-tick demonstration.

head_follow_up.note: The execution plan identity is unchanged because this implementation-only acquisition change is not a plan field; the control-plane commit disambiguates the runs.

cold_start_acquisition_follow_up.change: Before authenticated terminal supervision exists, frontier acquisition covers least-expanded farthest-first semantic archive cells instead of treating sparse action cost as goal evidence. Terminal-supported learned first-hit cost regains priority after a real terminal sample.

full_budget.wall_time_note: Another repo-local native campaign overlapped this run, so wall-rate deltas are intentionally not claimed.

cold_start_acquisition_follow_up.conclusion: The correction increased retained exploration breadth and useful evidence, and reached the old full-budget depth in one diagnostic seed after only 16 decisions. At 64 decisions it still converged on the same approximately 1,496-distance frontier without a terminal. The remaining blocker is downstream of cold-start frontier acquisition.

sustained_heading_follow_up.change: Ordinary relative-heading primitives expose 4, 8, 16, and 40 tick durations instead of only four ticks. This makes heading and duration independently available without embedding a route or assigning movement utility.
sustained_heading_follow_up.conclusion: Longer ordinary heading actions increased useful retained evidence but did not improve terminal discovery or geometric depth. A full 64-decision single-seed probe widened every decision to eight proposals, evaluated all four heading durations repeatedly, and still converged on the same approximately 1,496-distance frontier. Simple duration-lattice under-sampling is not the terminal barrier.

goal_relabel_follow_up.change: A separate value treatment relabels exact replay-achieved endpoint coordinates as temporary goals, backs negative native ticks through exact predecessor edges, and generalizes those goal-conditioned returns to live actions. Relabeled rows explicitly carry no native-terminal or promotion authority.

matched_diagnostic.wall_time_note: The diagnostic cells overlapped in native execution, so wall-rate differences are intentionally not claimed.

goal_relabel_follow_up.conclusion: Goal relabeling learned and transferred exact achieved-goal tick return without fabricating terminal support. It improved early geometric depth and state coverage against the current matched local control, but reduced useful evidence and converged on the existing approximately 1,496-distance full-budget plateau with no terminal. This treatment is not the P3 solution.

achieved_goal_frontier_follow_up.change: Before native terminal support exists, equally fresh retained frontiers are ordered first by supported achieved-goal return and then by least-expanded spatial reachability. Procedure, event, actor, and action-provenance modes remain in the retained archive and proposal mechanisms but cannot outrank spatial reachability during this cold-start branch acquisition. Achieved-goal support remains distinct from native-terminal and promotion authority.

interpretation.next_hypothesis: The best proposal starts from the westward envelope and consumes the complete 160-tick discovery horizon. Test a larger discovery horizon without changing native terminal, promotion, or final tick authority.

achieved_goal_frontier_follow_up.conclusion: Supported achieved-goal return demonstrably controls retained-frontier continuation without acquiring terminal authority. The matched full-budget treatment found no terminal, but improved the recorded goal-relabeled treatment's best proposal distance from approximately 1,496 to 1,323 and reached the replay's westward envelope. The best proposal consumed the complete 160-tick route horizon, making discovery-horizon truncation the next testable bottleneck rather than more mining at the same horizon.

demonstration_resolution_follow_up.change: The ordinary authenticated replay is segmented into four-tick transitions instead of 16-tick transitions. This preserves short setup inputs and delayed return at finer state/action resolution; it does not make recorded chunks executable policy choices, change reward, or grant promotion authority.
demonstration_resolution_follow_up.conclusion: Finer replay state/action resolution raised terminal discovery from 3/4 to 4/4 and improved the best generated candidate from tick 135 to tick 130, strictly beating the ordinary tick-131 sample. The policy is not capped by replay and does not execute recorded chunks. Scratch remained 0/4 under the later-proven-confounded 160-tick discovery horizon; the expanded-horizon follow-up records replay-independent scratch success.

discovery_horizon_follow_up.change: The per-route discovery horizon is treated as terminal-discovery capacity, independently of the unchanged 131-tick promotion threshold and final route objective.

confounded_control.interpretation: The earlier no-terminal result cannot distinguish learner failure from route truncation because its deepest useful route consumed the complete discovery horizon.

short_diagnostic.interpretation: The 16-decision cell never assembled a route longer than the old 160-tick cap and therefore did not exercise the treatment variable.

enforced_generous_independent_probe.wall_time_note: The four isolated learners and a separate shared-replay diagnostic executed concurrently. Outcome and route evidence are valid; capacity or wall-rate claims are intentionally excluded.

excluded_shared_replay_diagnostic.reason_excluded: Cross-seed replay is not independent and the cell used half the isolated decision budget.

decision_budget_follow_up.wall_time_note: The four isolated learners executed concurrently with a staggered start. Outcome and internal timing evidence are valid; no worker-scaling claim is made.
decision_budget_follow_up.interpretation: Doubling decisions did not improve terminal rate and shortened the best successful routes by only zero and one tick. The goal-relabeled achieved-goal critic deliberately carries no native-terminal authority, but it remained the active generalized critic after terminal discovery. Consequently every terminal-supported acquisition lacked a predicted total terminal tick cost. More mining cannot exercise the intended shortening comparator until native-terminal and achieved-goal critics are separated.

terminal_critic_handoff_probe.interpretation: After authenticated native-terminal support appears, the zero-terminal achieved-goal critic now hands authority to a separately fitted native-terminal critic. The exact prior seed and execution plan reproduced tick 206, and every later terminal-supported acquisition carried a learned total-tick prediction rather than null. This repairs terminal-cost availability but does not establish calibration or optimization: predictions spanned 51 to 211 ticks and the retained route did not improve.

lane_local_shared_replay_probe.change: Every authenticated transition remains global training evidence for the campaign-owned immutable critic. Peer routes and peer visited states no longer enter another lane's exploration frontier; each lane retains independent coverage while consuming shared value evidence.
lane_local_shared_replay_probe.conclusion: Global peer frontiers collapsed all four lanes onto a zero-terminal corridor. Keeping peer transitions in the shared critic while retaining lane-local frontier and visitation coverage raised authenticated terminal discovery to 3/4 under the identical full plan. Scratch discovery is now reliable, but the best tick-228 route remains far above the tick-131 demonstration.

terminal_critic_128_decision_probe.interpretation: The native-terminal critic and retained counterfactuals shortened the learner's own authenticated scratch route by 11 ticks without demonstration or incumbent authority. Improvement occurred by decisions 30 and 31; no later decision improved tick 195. Native-terminal self-refinement is therefore operational but remains poorly calibrated and plateaus 64 ticks above the tick-131 demonstration.

exact_terminal_frontier_probe.interpretation: Exact replay connectivity now outranks speculative k-NN terminal cost, and 15 retained-frontier acquisitions exercised proven terminal suffix states. The result did not improve tick 195. The one-worker execution plan assigned every retained frontier acquisition rank zero, which still routed the generalized proposal through demonstration-oriented behavior transfer instead of native-terminal learned-return ranking. Exact-path authority is correct, but scratch refinement remains policy-confounded.

unbounded_rank_cycle.conclusion: Rejected: broad rank cycling destroyed the stable discovery behavior.

bounded_frontier_cycle.conclusion: Rejected: cycling frontier ranks diluted exact-path refinement and did not improve the route.

fixed_exact_frontier_pure_learned_return.conclusion: Correct learned-return authority did not reproduce the isolated tick-195 improvement.

all_exact_endpoints_double_q.conclusion: Retaining all exact option endpoints and using Double-Q improved exact-path coverage but not route quality.

interpretation.next_required_change: Replay a learner-generated successful route into dense authenticated checkpoints and admit those states for branching without adding recorded chunks to the executable action catalog.

terminal_refinement_structure_probe.conclusion: The current campaign is temporally under-resolved for the optimization claim. It can branch only at tactic-option endpoints, including gaps of 40 native ticks, so learned return cannot test corrections at the interior frames where route quality is determined. The tick-195 result is a single favorable counterfactual, not proof of a robust route optimizer.

discovery_horizon_follow_up.conclusion: The learner reached the real terminal from scratch once route discovery received adequate time. Isolated learners reproduced terminals in 2/4 seeds, and separating global value evidence from lane-local frontier coverage raised the matched shared-replay result from 0/4 to 3/4. A separate native-terminal critic supplies total-tick predictions after genuine terminal support, but the only improvement from tick 206 to tick 195 did not reproduce across controlled refinement variants. Scratch discovery is established; robust self-refinement is not. Endpoint-only branching leaves gaps as large as 40 native ticks and invalidates fine route-optimization claims until the learner receives dense authenticated states along its own successful routes.
